period_choice: Pre-pandemic normal check uses FY2016/17 baseline with FY2017/18-FY2018/19 outcomes. Late recovery uses official FY2018/19 baseline with FY2022/23-FY2024/25 outcomes; shutdown FY2020/21-FY2021/22 intentionally omitted so comparison is not mechanically driven by closure.
interpretation: If late-recovery masking remains materially larger than normal-period masking in the same museums, multi-mission divergence is more than a generic property of any annual comparison. This is descriptive, not a statistical treatment effect.
